i.norm: When the actual Levenshtein distance between two strings exceeds the configured threshold, apply() must return a result whose distance is -1. Setup: - left : CharBuffer of 13 null characters (capacity 13, all '�') - right : "E6sZn1lY$kTP*\"" (14 characters, none of which match '�') - threshold : 13 Because the right side is longer than the threshold and every character differs, the true edit distance (14) exceeds the threshold (13), so the limited algorithm returns -1 without computing the full distance.
A 13-character CharBuffer filled with null characters ('�')
